overview:
# Git Advanced Workflows Demonstration
## Software Development Team Simulation

functional_requirements.title: Persistent Storage
functional_requirements.description: JSON file-based storage with automatic backups

functional_requirements.title: Comprehensive Validation
functional_requirements.description: Business rule validation with detailed error reporting

functional_requirements.title: RESTful API
functional_requirements.description: Complete HTTP API with proper error handling

functional_requirements.title: Task Structure
functional_requirements.description: ID, title, description, priority, status, tags, due dates

functional_requirements.title: Text Search
functional_requirements.description: Search in title, description, and tags

functional_requirements.title: Status Filtering
functional_requirements.description: Filter by task status (pending, in-progress, completed, cancelled)

functional_requirements.title: Priority Filtering
functional_requirements.description: Filter by priority levels (low, medium, high, urgent)

functional_requirements.title: IDs
functional_requirements.description: Format validation for user and project IDs

functional_requirements.title: User Isolation
functional_requirements.description: Users can only access their own tasks (unless admin)

functional_requirements.title: Audit Logging
functional_requirements.description: Complete audit trail of all operations

functional_requirements.title: Memory Efficient
functional_requirements.description: Efficient data structures and garbage collection

functional_requirements.title: Caching
functional_requirements.description: In-memory caching with configurable TTL (future enhancement)

functional_requirements.title: Real-time Updates
functional_requirements.description: Server-Sent Events replace client-side state management

functional_requirements.title: Filtering/Sorting
functional_requirements.description: Server-side implementation of all frontend features

functional_requirements.title: Encryption
functional_requirements.description: Data encryption at rest and in transit

functional_requirements.title: Documentation
functional_requirements.description: This README and inline code documentation

functional_requirements.title: Issues
functional_requirements.description: GitHub issues for bug reports and feature requests

functional_requirements.title: Discussions
functional_requirements.description: GitHub discussions for questions and ideas

functional_requirements.title: E2E Tests:
functional_requirements.description: Complete user registration and login flows

functional_requirements.title: Production tags
functional_requirements.description: Requires approval from tech lead and product owner

functional_requirements.title: Merge strategy
functional_requirements.description: Squash and merge or merge commit

functional_requirements.title: Corrupted Tag
functional_requirements.description: Delete and recreate with proper annotation

functional_requirements.title: Automation
functional_requirements.description: Use scripts for consistent tag creation

functional_requirements.title: Documentation
functional_requirements.description: Keep tag strategy up to date

functional_requirements.title: Examples on extending the basic functionalities
